# Gamekult — Robin Hood : le desperado des bois

- Original source: [Gamekult — Robin Hood : le desperado des bois](https://www.gamekult.com/jeux/robin-hood-la-legende-de-sherwood-21697/test.html)
- Author / publication: Gaël Fouquet (Poischich) / Gamekult
- Language / date: French; 2002-11-22
- Access: Indexed article body and verdict inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Gamekult awards 5/10 to the commercial review version. Fouquet praises the character roster, large environments, attractive graphics, French localization, and effective pathfinding, but regards the design as a limited advance on its genre predecessors.

The central criticism is that frequent, forgiving fights weaken the incentive to infiltrate carefully. Visual clutter and the fixed camera also make encounters harder to read. This provides a useful contemporary counterpoint to reviews that treat forgiving combat as an accessibility advantage.

The assessment concerns the reviewed 2002 release; it does not establish the behavior of later ports or compatibility packages.
